title_sq: Apartanent 3+1+2 ne shitje tek Kompleksi Panoram
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 3+1+1+2 ne katin e 3 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor ne Rrugen Panorama prane Hipotekes. Apartamenti organizohet nga nje korridor i cili ben shperndarjen ne 1 soxhorno te bollshme, 1 dhome gatimi, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 1 ballkon. Apartanenti ka orientim jug - lindje, eshte i investuar ne detaje nga pronaret, i shtruar i gjithi me parket, dyer Italiane cilesore, vetrata termike dopio xham i cili eshte me foto - element, kondicionere ne cdo ambjent, kuzhina eshte me vete dhe e pajisur me te gjitha elektroshtepiaket te markave me te njohura. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara per banim pasi ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme dhe ka akses te menjehershem me te gjitha rruget kryesore dhe ndodhet shume prane unazes se vogel.

title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale in Panorama Complex
description_en: 3+1+1+2 apartment for sale on the 3rd floor of a new building with elevator on Panorama Street near Hipotek. The apartment is organized by a corridor which divides it into 1 spacious living room, 1 kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. The apartment has a south-east orientation, it is invested in details by the owners, all laid with parquet, quality Italian doors, double-glazed thermal windows with photo-element, air conditioners in every room, the kitchen is self-contained and equipped with all the most popular brands of appliances. The apartment is located in one of the most sought-after residential areas as it offers all the necessary facilities and has immediate access to all major roads and is located very close to the small ring road. 530411003-516 For more information, contact us.
